records.text: Blue dragonspawn are dragonkin found in Azshara.
Kurll is a food-and-drink seller in Azshara who may also ask for help with tasks.
Azuregos guards the arcane mysteries of Azshara, declaring the place under his protection and the mysteries inviolate. He treats trespass as a threat and calls a deadly fight the price of curiosity.

A Highborne Apparition is one of the restless spirits haunting the Shadowsong Shrine in Azshara. Loh'atu describes these spirits as bound to mortal existence and asks for help releasing them; the apparition is among those he identifies as targets.

A Highborne Lichling is one of the restless spirits haunting the Shadowsong Shrine in Azshara. Loh'atu describes these spirits as bound to mortal existence and asks for help releasing them; the lichling is among those he identifies as targets.
Varo'then's Ghost is a hostile undead apparition at the Shadowsong Shrine in Azshara.
A Haldarr satyr of the clan in Azshara, counted among the creatures Loh’atu asks adventurers to defeat.
A Haldarr trickster of the clan in Azshara, counted among the creatures Loh’atu asks adventurers to defeat.
A Haldarr felsworn of the clan in Azshara, counted among the creatures Loh’atu asks adventurers to defeat. It can cast Summon Imp outside combat.
A Draconic Magelord, a dragonkin found in Azshara.
A Blue Scalebane, a dragonkin found in Azshara.
A Draconic Mageweaver, a dragonkin of Azshara, who fights with spells.

Lord Arkkoroc is a gigantic lesser deity of Azshara whose children were killed by Hetaera, the ocean ruler he calls a false god. He bargains with mortals for her heads, promising the name they seek and something more; after they are brought to him, he names the demon lord Razelikh the Defiler and squeezes blood from the heads to prepare a weapon temper. His exchange joins personal vengeance to a specific role in preparing the weapon against Razelikh.
An Arkkoran Clacker, a humanoid of Azshara.
An Arkkoran Muckdweller, a humanoid of Azshara.
An Arkkoran Pincer, a humanoid of Azshara.
An Arkkoran Oracle, a humanoid of Azshara.

Hetaera is the ocean ruler whom Lord Arkkoroc accuses of killing his children and calls a false god. He sends mortals to bring back her heads, making her the focus of his vengeance and the price of the information he promises. Her own recorded place is in Azshara's waters.
A giant who serves Arkkoroc.
A Son of Arkkoroc, a giant of Azshara.
A Cliff Breaker, a giant of Azshara.
A Cliff Thunderer, a giant of Azshara.
A Cliff Walker, a giant of Azshara.
A Timbermaw Pathfinder, a humanoid of Azshara.
A Timbermaw Warrior, a humanoid fighter of Azshara.
A Timbermaw Totemic, a humanoid of Azshara who draws on totem magic.
A Timbermaw Den Watcher, stationed at the clan's den.
A Timbermaw shaman, a humanoid spellcaster of Azshara.
A Timbermaw ursa. It casts a spell when its health falls within a certain range.
A Spitelash warrior of Azshara.
A Spitelash screamer of Azshara.
A Spitelash Serpent Guard. A polymorph spell hit triggers a scripted response.
A Spitelash siren. A polymorph spell hit triggers a scripted response.
A Spitelash Myrmidon stationed among the Azshara peninsula’s local population. It can fight and respond to polymorph magic.
A Blood Elf Surveyor working in the Azshara peninsula. The title identifies a surveying role, and the Betrayed quest names surveyors among Magus Rimtori’s workers targeted by the Alliance’s campaign.

A Blood Elf Reclaimer among Magus Rimtori’s workers on the northern Azshara peninsula. In Betrayed, Alliance forces are directed to kill reclaimers as part of a campaign against those workers. This reclaimer can fight.
A Legashi Satyr found in the Azshara peninsula. It uses magic in combat.
A Legashi Rogue found in the Azshara peninsula. This rogue fights with a combat ability.
A Legashi Hellcaller found in the Azshara peninsula. Its title identifies a distinct role among the Legashi. It uses a combat spell.
A young wavethrasher, a beast represented in Azshara as a creature of the local population.
Wavethrasher is an amphibious beast found along the Azshara coast. It is powerful and resilient, and its tough, reflective scales are prized by hunters.
Great Wavethrasher is a larger wavethrasher found in Azshara. It is a powerful amphibious beast, and its tough, reflective scales are sought by hunters.
Makrinni Razorclaw is a humanoid in Azshara.
A Storm Bay Oracle, a humanoid of Azshara.
Coralshell Lurker is a beast found across several areas of Azshara.
Coralshell Tortoise is a tortoise found in one area of Azshara.
Makrinni Scrabblers are humanoids who hurl frost magic at their foes and mend themselves when badly hurt.
Storm Bay Warriors are humanoid combatants. They use a combat ability.
Makrinni Snapclaw is a humanoid found in Azshara.
Thunderhead Hippogryphs are beasts. They attack with a spell when provoked.
Thunderhead Stagwings are beasts. Their combat behavior includes a spell.
Thunderhead Skystormers are beasts. They attack with a spell when provoked.
Thunderhead Patriarch is a beast of the Thunderhead population. Its name suggests a patriarchal role.
Thunderhead Consort is a beast of the Thunderhead population, represented across several areas. Its name suggests a consort role.
Monnos the Elder is a giant in Azshara.
Magister Hawkhelm is a humanoid magister in Azshara.
Antilos is a beast in Azshara.
Lady Sesspira is a humanoid in Azshara.
General Fangferror is a humanoid general in Azshara.
Gatekeeper Rageroar is a humanoid gatekeeper in Azshara.
Master Feardred is a demon found in Azshara.

Loramus Thalipedes is a demon hunter who invites those facing demons to hear his story. He offers to help bring down one of Razelikh's minions and works to break the ward protecting Razelikh's subordinates, which takes rare artifacts and an enlightenment ritual. He also tells fighters to summon a felhound tracker to find Azsharite for the body of a weapon.
A Lingering Highborne is an undead presence wandering the Ruins of Eldarath. Its evil can coalesce into Ichor of Undeath, a potent ingredient in Ogtinc’s restorative salve.

Peter Galen is Azshara’s dragonscale leatherworking trainer. He teaches the specialization and offers an option to unlearn it, presenting the craft as a committed choice among three competing paths. His apprenticeship quest asks students for scorpid armor samples and dragonkin scales. His line to dragon hunters has a dry, wry edge.
The Spitelash Battlemaster is a martial combatant found in Azshara. It can respond to Polymorph with a follow-up sequence, a distinctive part of its combat behavior.

The Spitelash Enchantress is a spellcasting combatant found in Azshara. In battle she uses Arcane Missiles and Enchanted Quickness, defining her role through offensive magic and a self-enhancing spell.
Alexandra Blazen is a humanoid in Azshara who steels herself with Inner Fire when a fight begins.

Archmage Xylem is an Azshara mage whose research draws him into several dealings with the region’s dangers. He seeks rare components and magical materials, and helps Lord Ravenholdt remove an enchantment from a bag. His response to Jediga’s tablet shows eagerness to study it and satisfaction with their bargain; restoring his ability to forge the arcane leads him to offer the visitor a choice of creation.

Captain Vanessa Beltis is the captain of the Horizon Scout, whose wreck left her crew and passengers exposed to naga attacks near Azshara. She prepares for another assault and calls on help to defend the survivors. After the battle, her gratitude is tempered by grief for crew members who died; she directs the visitor to surviving passengers who may need help.
Lindros is a humanoid who hurls fireballs at his foes.
Patrick Mills is a humanoid who fights with holy strikes and a devotion aura.
A Horizon Scout crewman.
A Horizon Scout First Mate.
A Horizon Scout Cook.
A Horizon Scout Engineer.
Roland Geardabbler is a humanoid in Azshara.

Sanath Lim-yo is Archmage Xylem’s arrogant servant at the camp below his tower in Azshara. He says he now follows Xylem’s orders to send visitors to his master, though he once had more freedom to ask favors of those seeking Xylem. He mocks visitors’ clothes and appearance, but says even that has become boring.
Sentinel Keldara Sunblade is an Azshara sentinel.

Nyrill identifies himself as Master Xylem’s apprentice. He welcomes visitors’ concerns for his master and says he can return them to the base of the mountain; his quest text names Sanath’s camp as the destination. Nyrill describes Sanath as rude to everyone except Xylem and hopes he will learn better manners.

Ogtinc has turned from hunting to teaching hunters. His trials use Azshara’s coursers, wavethrashers and the green drake Morphaz to teach confidence, resilience and the strength found in allies. He also asks hunters to gather ingredients for a restorative salve to help heal Felwood.
Caravan Master Tset is a humanoid caravan master in Azshara.

Kim'jael is a goblin merchant who joined the Blood Elves' search for treasure in Azshara, only to be betrayed and left without his gear. Still bitter, he turns their lost equipment and rune hunt into a chance to profit and get even. Learning what the rune was meant for, he relishes the prospect of frustrating Magus Rimtori.
Second Mate Shandril is a humanoid in Azshara.

Ag'tor Bloodfist leads a campaign against Magus Rimtori after she killed the dozen warriors stationed with him and betrayed Belgrom. He says she manipulated and seduced Belgrom, though he admits he might have made the same choice. His plan is measured: strike her workers, scout her camp for a way to provoke her, then take the fight to her. He hopes Rimtori's death will let his warriors' spirits rest.
Haggrum Bloodfist is an orc living in the Azshara wilderness. He recalls camping there alone with his brother and reflects on how the wilderness has changed.

Jediga is a Forsaken in Azshara who says Belgrom's punishment has benefited her. She gathers Highborne tablets to sell through contacts including Magatha, Jes'rimon, and Andron, keeping a share of the profits. She describes Magatha as reasonable, values Jes'rimon's reliable information and well-paying work despite his attitude, and is amused when Andron overpays. Her dealings also involve Xylem.
Kroum is a Wind Rider Master who offers fast travel. He also calls for guards, and he can summon an enraged wyvern when he is attacked.
The Evalcharr is a beast.
Jubie Gadgetspring sells engineering supplies in Azshara and invites visitors to browse the goods.
Raytaf is one of the guardians associated with Loramus.
Shahiar is one of the guardians associated with Loramus.
Zaman is one of the guardians associated with Loramus.
The Mosshoof Runner is a beast found across several areas of the region, including the area of Loramus's guardians.
The Mosshoof Stag is a beast found in two areas of the region.
Timberweb Recluses are a local population of spider creatures found across several areas.
Mistwing Rogues are creatures found in a small number of areas.
Mistwing Ravagers are creatures found in several areas.
Forest Oozes are ooze creatures found across several areas.
Gruul Darkblade is a weaponsmith who offers goods for browsing.
Azshara Sentinels are humanoid creatures whose name denotes a sentinel role.

Loh'atu has sworn to the Earthmother to help the night elves rid their sacred lands of satyrs, and promised the Sentinels to release troubled Highborne spirits. Loh'atu welcomes help even from those who do not worship the Earthmother, seeing such service as worthy of respect beyond faction conflict. In thanks, Loh'atu shares local knowledge while admitting it is limited.
Rayan Dawnrisen is a named individual found in Azshara.
Joy Ar'nareth is a named individual found in Azshara.
Coral Moongale is a named individual found in Azshara.
Jarrodenus is a hippogryph master who handles travelers’ flight inquiries. His greeting asks where they would like to fly.
Blimo Gadgetspring sells trade supplies to visitors in Azshara.

Duke Hydraxis leads the Hydraxian Waterlords’ war against the elemental lords, recruiting capable allies to weaken their servants. He tests their service against increasingly powerful foes, from lesser enemies to the Pyroguard Emberseer and, in a final campaign, the Molten Core captains Lucifron, Sulfuron, Gehennas and Shazzrah. Hydraxis regards the Waterlords’ struggle as a matter of elemental purity and values proven allies, while acknowledging that outsiders cannot fully understand it. His campaign seeks to strike a terrible blow against the Firelords.
The Hydraxian Honor Guard directs visitors to speak with Hydraxis and turns away those it considers to have no business with it.
Scalebeard is a beast of Azshara.
Brinna Valanaar is a bowyer who offers goods for sale.
Thundering Invaders are elemental combatants that cast Earth Shock.
Avalanchion is an elemental antagonist who announces his arrival, threatens mortals, and promises to return after defeat.
The Spirit of Azuregos describes his watch as eternal and responds to a visitor seeking the scepter shard charged to the Blue Flight's protection.
Elder Skygleam speaks of the stars as changing beacons of hope and strength for coming ages. Visitors can ask him about the whereabouts of four other elders.

place_records.text: You are in Azshara, a contested land on Kalimdor where both the Alliance and the Horde keep settlements. The Horde holds Valormok and the Alliance holds Talrendis Point. Cliff giants, Thunderhead and Spitelash creatures, and Timbermaw warriors make much of the land dangerous.
You are in Timbermaw Hold in Azshara. Timbermaw warriors, pathfinders, shamans and den watchers are the main dangers, with timberweb recluses and thunderhead stagwings nearby.

You are in Legash Encampment in Azshara, where a spirit healer offers a return to life for a price. Kim'jael, a goblin betrayed by the Blood Elves, is still bitter and turns their lost equipment and rune hunt into a chance to profit. Legashi rogues, satyrs and hellcallers, with thunderhead skystormers nearby, are the dangers.

You are in Thalassian Base Camp in Azshara. Blood elf reclaimers and surveyors, thunderhead skystormers and Magister Hawkhelm are its dangers. Arcane focusing crystals tied to a magus named Rimtori still stand in the camp.

You are in the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara, where Peter Galen, the dragonscale leatherworking trainer, is found. Spitelash serpent guards, sirens, screamers and warriors fill the ruins, and lingering highborne wander them.
You are in Hetaera's Clutch in Azshara, where Hetaera roams. Lord Arkkoroc calls her a false god. Sons and servants of Arkkoroc and mammoth sharks are also dangerous here.

You are in the Temple of Zin-Malor in Azshara, where spitelash serpent guards, sirens and myrmidons gather. Warlord Krellian and General Fangferror are among its dangers, and lingering highborne haunt it too.

You are in Bear's Head in Azshara, where Archmage Xylem researches with rare components and magical materials. Timbermaw warriors, pathfinders and totemics, with timberweb recluses and thunderhead stagwings, are the dangers. Xylem's apprentice was consumed by the green drake Morphaz in the sunken temple of Atal'Hakkar.
You are in Ursolan in Azshara, where a spirit healer offers a return to life for a price. Timbermaw ursas, shamans and den watchers roam here, with thunderhead skystormers and stagwings close by.

You are in the Temple of Arkkoran in Azshara, where Lord Arkkoroc, a gigantic lesser deity, bargains with mortals for Hetaera's heads. Arkkoran pincers, oracles, clackers and muckdwellers guard the temple, and makrinni scrabblers are also here.

You are in the Bay of Storms in Azshara, where the demon hunter Loramus Thalipedes tells his story to those facing demons. Duke Hydraxis leads the Hydraxian Waterlords' war against the elemental lords, and the Hydraxian Honor Guard turns away visitors it judges unworthy. Storm Bay oracles, makrinni razorclaws and great wavethrashers are the dangers.

You are in The Shattered Strand in Azshara, where Ogtinc, who turned from hunting to teaching, runs trials using coursers, wavethrashers and the green drake Morphaz. Spitelash myrmidons and sirens, makrinni scrabblers and storm bay warriors are the dangers.
You are in the Tower of Eldara in Azshara. Wavethrashers, storm bay warriors and makrinni scrabblers are the dangers here, and coralshell lurkers are found in the area.

You are in Jagged Reef, a stretch of Azshara's coast. Storm Bay warriors and wavethrashers, along with Makrinni snapclaws and a mammoth shark, make its waters dangerous. Coralshell lurkers and tortoises live among the reefs.

You are in Southridge Beach, a coast in Azshara where a spirit healer offers a return to the living for a price, though it may not yet be your time. Spitelash myrmidons and sirens, and Makrinni razorclaws, prowl the shore.
You are in Ravencrest Monument, a place in Azshara. Spitelash battlemasters and enchantresses patrol the ground here.
You are in Forlorn Ridge, a ridge in Azshara where a spirit healer offers a return to life for a price, though it may not yet be your time. Forest oozes are found here too.

You are in Lake Mennar, a lake in Azshara. Draconic mageweavers and magelords, blue scalebanes and dragonspawn, and thunderhead stagwings make the lake dangerous. Mosshoof stags, a beast of the region, are found here as well.

You are in Haldarr Encampment, an Azshara camp where Alliance sentinels keep watch. Sentinel Keldara Sunblade is one of them. Haldarr satyrs, tricksters and felsworn, along with thunderhead hippogryphs, make the surrounding land dangerous.

You are in Valormok, a Horde outpost in Azshara with a flight master and vendors. Ag'tor Bloodfist leads a campaign against Magus Rimtori, who killed a dozen warriors stationed with him and betrayed Belgrom. Forsaken Jediga gathers Highborne tablets to sell through her contacts, and timberweb recluses and thunderhead hippogryphs prowl the edges.

You are in The Ruined Reaches, an area of Azshara where the Horizon Scout was wrecked. Captain Vanessa Beltis, whose ship was wrecked, prepares to defend her survivors from another naga attack. Jubie and Blimo Gadgetspring sell engineering and trade supplies, and storm bay oracles and great wavethrashers make the area dangerous.
You are in Bitter Reaches, an area of Azshara. Thunderhead consorts and patriarchs, cliff walkers, cliff breakers and cliff thunderers, and forest oozes make the ground dangerous.

You are in Talrendis Point, an Alliance settlement in Azshara with a hippogryph master, a bowyer and Azshara sentinels. Loh'atu has sworn to the Earthmother to rid the sacred lands of satyrs and to release troubled Highborne spirits.
